description: This file defines functions and types for sending messages via Mattermost, including target parsing, channel resolution, media handling, and message posting.

methods.name: recordMattermostOutboundActivity
methods.description: Records outbound activity for a given Mattermost account.

methods.name: cacheKey
methods.description: Generates a cache key based on baseUrl and token.

methods.name: normalizeMessage
methods.description: Concatenates message text and media URL into a normalized message string.

methods.name: isHttpUrl
methods.description: Checks if a string is an HTTP or HTTPS URL.

methods.name: parseMattermostTarget
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a MattermostTarget object, identifying channel or user targets.

methods.name: resolveBotUser
methods.description: Resolves and caches the bot user for a given baseUrl and token.

methods.name: resolveUserIdByUsername
methods.description: Resolves a user ID from a username, with caching.

methods.name: resolveChannelIdByName
methods.description: Resolves a channel ID from a channel name, searching across teams.

methods.name: mergeDmRetryOptions
methods.description: Merges default and override retry options for direct message channel creation.

methods.name: resolveTargetChannelId
methods.description: Resolves the channel ID for a given target, creating DMs if necessary.

methods.name: resolveMattermostSendContext
methods.description: Builds context needed to send a message, including resolving target channel ID.

methods.name: resolveMattermostSendChannelId
methods.description: Returns the channel ID for a given recipient string.

methods.name: sendMessageMattermost
methods.description: Sends a message to a Mattermost target, handling media uploads and message formatting.
